import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep (colored by Sleep Disorder)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
for disorder in df['Sleep Disorder'].unique():
    if pd.isna(disorder):
        mask = df['Sleep Disorder'].isna()
        label = 'None'
    else:
        mask = df['Sleep Disorder'] == disorder
        label = disorder
    ax1.scatter(df[mask]['Sleep Duration'], df[mask]['Quality of Sleep'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=100, label=label)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(fontsize=8)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Age Distribution by Gender
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
gender_data = [df[df['Gender'] == g]['Age'].values for g in df['Gender'].unique()]
ax2.boxplot(gender_data, labels=df['Gender'].unique(), patch_artist=True)
ax2.set_ylabel('Age', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Gender', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 3. BMI Category Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
ax3.bar(range(len(bmi_counts)), bmi_counts.values, color=colors[:len(bmi_counts)])
ax3.set_xticks(range(len(bmi_counts)))
ax3.set_xticklabels(bmi_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax3.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 4. Physical Activity vs Stress Level
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
scatter = ax4.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Stress Level'], 
                     c=df['Quality of Sleep'], cmap='RdYlGn', s=100, alpha=0.6)
ax4.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Stress Level', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Physical Activity vs Stress', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax4, label='Sleep Quality')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 5. Daily Steps Distribution
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
ax5.hist(df['Daily Steps'], bins=15, color=colors[2], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax5.set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Daily Steps Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 6. Heart Rate by BMI Category
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
bmi_categories = df['BMI Category'].unique()
heart_rate_data = [df[df['BMI Category'] == cat]['Heart Rate'].values for cat in bmi_categories]
bp = ax6.boxplot(heart_rate_data, labels=bmi_categories, patch_artist=True)
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], colors):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
ax6.set_xticklabels(bmi_categories, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax6.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Heart Rate by BMI Category', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 7. Occupation Distribution
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
occupation_counts = df['Occupation'].value_counts().head(8)
ax7.barh(range(len(occupation_counts)), occupation_counts.values, color=colors[:len(occupation_counts)])
ax7.set_yticks(range(len(occupation_counts)))
ax7.set_yticklabels(occupation_counts.index, fontsize=9)
ax7.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_title('Top Occupations', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='x')

# 8. Sleep Disorder Distribution
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
sleep_disorder_counts = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None').value_counts()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax8.pie(sleep_disorder_counts.values, labels=sleep_disorder_counts.index, 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors[:len(sleep_disorder_counts)])
ax8.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontsize(9)
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 9. Correlation Heatmap
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', center=0, 
            ax=ax9, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8}, annot_kws={'fontsize': 7})
ax9.set_title('Correlation Matrix', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax9.tick_params(labelsize=8)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
